notes.title: Free Content Update: New Special Levels Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey Ynglet,

You may have noticed that [i]Ynglet[/i] had an update today! We have released a free content update which adds new and more challenging special levels to really test your skills. I hope you aren’t too rusty because you will need to combine all the tricks you have learned from the previous levels to traverse through the new special levels.

- Riv otter

notes.title: Free content update coming October 17th
notes.content:
Hey Ynglet,

If you were watching the Akupara Games 8th anniversary live stream, you would have seen that the relaxing Ynglet will be receiving new DLC content. Here is the trailer if you missed it!

[previewyoutube=KJtEUeXcOls;full][/previewyoutube]

The free content update will include new special levels to traverse through and and new atmospheric music to relax to. Mark your calendars for October 17th.

- Riv otter

notes.title: Ynglet Content Update
notes.content:
We have big news: we’ve just launched a big content update for Ynglet!

Ynglet has just launched on Xbox, and with the launch brings new content to the game, that’s available now on PC and Mac!

With new levels, new mechanics and a secret minigame, we hope you’ll love checking out the update.

Changelog: 
[list]
[*] A new Bonus World, which contains 19 new levels!
[*] Including new and unique mechanics and lots of generated music and a new achievement
[*] A secret unlockable mini game, which you get for completing the Story World in Negative Mode
[*] Audio volume option
[*] New loading screen
[*] Faster loading times
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉🎉🎉YNGLET IS OUT NOW! 🎉🎉🎉
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=NCc7NO5P_48;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]IT'S OUT![/h1]

As just announced on the Guerrilla Collective Stream, Ynglet is out! 

You can now experience the fantastic, mesmerising meditative floating platformer by Nifflas right now!!!

With features including:

- Absolutely no platforms (which is really unusual for a platformer)!

- Jump between bubbles that float in the sky like you’re a space dolphin!

- Dash into walls that reflect you. It feels really good and looks awesome!

- Did we mention there are no platforms?

- A highly reactive and dynamic soundtrack thanks to Ynglet’s custom and needlessly complicated music software.

- Lots of unusual creatures doing their own thing, making the world feel alive


We can't wait to hear about your journeys in this unique and beautiful world. 

❤️❤️❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36797675/55ae231fb90aee3c614e6017a6605a5697808a51.png[/img]
